item.summary:
fix(gateway): stop agent terminal processes after session archive (#125784) * fix(gateway): stop terminal PTYs on session archive Bind agent terminals to the durable session incarnation, drain exact ownership during archive, and terminate every job-control process group in the PTY session.

Closes #125769 * test(gateway): cover terminal cleanup on archive * test(gateway): align terminal outcome assertions * test(gateway): preserve session exports in invoke test * fix(gateway): await terminal exit before archive * test(codex): consolidate supervised instruction coverage Move the duplicated two-attempt regression into the canonical thread lifecycle test so the exact two-worker extension shard stays bounded on low-core CI.
